string.text: ADS zoom: FOV zoom (world FOV, cap 15; magnified scopes keep their own). Irons / Sights / Scopes set HUD only (caps 15 / 25 / 35; 0 = off). Free zoom clears on ADS; ADS clears when you leave ADS (including reload). Disable Adjustable Scope View. Blindside/3DSS ADS FOV scripts are blanked by DOGMA.
Raising binoculars starts at full zoom-out (scroll wheel back), not max zoom-in.
World FOV while ADS (irons and non-magnified sights). Cap 15%. 0 = off. Magnified scopes keep their own world FOV.
HUD FOV for iron sights. Cap 15%. 0 = off.
HUD FOV for non-magnified sights. Cap 25%. 0 = off.
HUD FOV for magnified scopes. Cap 35%. 0 = off. World FOV stays with the scope.
Peripheral (edge) blur while ADS. Uses SSFX Weapons DOF; prior DOF is restored when you leave ADS. Intensity below is per irons / sights / scopes.
Edge blur strength while ADS with iron sights. 0 = off for irons.
Edge blur strength while ADS with non-magnified sights. 0 = off for sights.
Edge blur strength while ADS with magnified scopes. 0 = off for scopes.
Press: +5% HUD zoom for this weapon and irons/sight/scope. Only while ADS.
Press: -5% HUD zoom for this weapon and irons/sight/scope. Only while ADS.
Clears the HUD override for this weapon and irons/sight/scope. Uses the Irons/Sights/Scopes default again.
